description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，再调用本接口删除导播台节目单。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为4次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
First, call the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation to create a production studio. Then, call this operation to delete the program of the production studio.

## Usage limits

You can call this operation up to 4 queries per second (QPS) per account. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This can affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-caster-program --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
